text:
Slide One
This is the first slide.
When this presentation is served as example-slides.html, a “Webpage version” button will appear in the top-right corner linking to example.html#slide-one.

title: RevealJS HTML Links Example
text:
Slide Two
This is the second slide.
The link in the top-right corner updates automatically as you navigate between slides, always pointing to the corresponding section of the HTML notes document.

title: revealjs-html-links
text:
This extension adds a persistent “Webpage version” button to RevealJS presentations that links back to the corresponding HTML notes document.
Use quarto add d-morrison/revealjs-html-links in your Quarto project, then enable the filter:
filters:
  - d-morrison/revealjs-html-links
See example.qmd for a minimal working example.
